scenes.headline: How to query 460 GB without downloading it
scenes.sub: Parquet footers, column chunks and range requests
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Jamun! A new dataset holds metadata for five point six billion TikTok videos. Here's how one laptop queries it without downloading it.

scenes.text: Every Parquet file ends with an index. Read it first, and a query fetches only the byte ranges it needs.
scenes.mark: only the byte ranges it needs
scenes.say: Every Parquet file ends with an index. Read that first, and a query fetches only the byte ranges it actually needs.

scenes.title: One query, a few byte ranges

steps.say: The reader asks for the file's last eight bytes. They point to the footer, which says where every column of every row group sits.
Each row group carries the minimum and maximum of every column, so groups outside the filter are skipped.
For each group it keeps, it fetches only the named column, one range request each.
Everything else in the file is never sent.

scenes.title: How the files are laid out

items.say: One Parquet file per month, a hundred and forty-eight in all.
Each column is compressed on its own. Captions and hashtags are most of the bytes.
Every column also has a bloom filter, for exact lookups.

scenes.label: fetched from a 10.95 GB file to sum a month of views
scenes.say: Summing one month of views fetched under two hundred megabytes from an eleven gigabyte file. The footers predicted it almost exactly.

scenes.title: A one-day filter: share of the month read
scenes.say: Inside a month, pruning is weaker. A third of September's row groups span the whole month, so one day still reads close to half of it.

scenes.credit: measured by this article from the footers
scenes.title: Rows per monthly file

steps.say: Rows per month, read straight from the footers. In twenty twenty, one month holds seventy-six million rows and the next holds twenty-nine million.
Steps like that belong to the crawler, not to TikTok.

scenes.text: The footer is the index. Read it first, and a query costs only the columns and months it names.

recap: Text columns are most of the bytes
scenes.say: Footer first, then byte ranges. Text is most of the bytes. And the monthly counts measure the crawler.
